title: Practice 5: Cause in a complex sentence

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: I only drive magic carpets because I'm a rug addict.
exercises.ru: Я езжу на коврах-самолётах, только ___ я коврофил.
exercises.why: Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The power plant was mothballed because of its outdated technology.
exercises.ru: Электростанция была законсервирована ___ устаревшей технологии.
exercises.why: «из-за — from behind; because of» (+ genitive); «благодаря + Dat. — thanks to». — DLI, Lessons 60, 103. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
